_comment: Curated site catalog -> pipeline/jobs/sites.py -> data/web/sites.json (docs/DATA.md §4). Longitudes east-positive (-180..180). Never invent coordinates: every entry has a source; 'approx' entries explain why in 'note'. PGDA 5 m entries: the point is recomputed by sites.py as the highest DEM point within the central 60% of the 5 m DEM (coordQuality 'dem-summit'; DEM centre/bbox kept as demCentre/demBbox); the lat/lon below (DEM centres from the GeoTIFF headers) is only a fallback.

sites.name: Connecting ridge
sites.note: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache craters; one of the best-lit places at the pole. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.note: Rim of Shackleton crater next to the south pole. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Nobile rim 1
sites.note: Rim of Nobile crater near Mons Mouton. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Peak near Shackleton
sites.note: Peak on the far side of Shackleton crater. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: de Gerlache rim
sites.note: Rim of de Gerlache crater. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Leibnitz beta plateau
sites.note: Plateau of Mons Mouton (formerly Leibnitz beta). Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Malapert massif
sites.note: Malapert massif, facing the Earth. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Haworth
sites.note: Area around Haworth crater. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Shoemaker
sites.note: Area around Shoemaker crater. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Nobile rim 2
sites.note: Second Nobile rim site. Centre of the 5 m LOLA DEM.

sites.name: Peak near Cabeus B
sites.note: Artemis III candidate region; NASA publishes no centre point - this is the centre of LROC's NAC mosaic of the region (0.1 deg).

sites.name: Haworth (Artemis III region)
sites.note: Artemis III candidate region; centre of LROC's NAC mosaic of the region, not an official point.

sites.name: Malapert Massif (Artemis III region)
sites.note: Artemis III candidate region; centre of LROC's NAC mosaic of the region, not an official point.

sites.name: Mons Mouton Plateau
sites.note: Artemis III candidate region; centre of LROC's NAC mosaic (spans 82.9-85.8 S), not an official point.

sites.name: Mons Mouton / Nobile Rim 1
sites.note: Two Artemis III candidate regions covered by one LROC NAC mosaic; mosaic centre, not an official point.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 2 (Artemis III region)
sites.note: Artemis III candidate region; centre of LROC's NAC mosaic of the region, not an official point.

sites.name: de Gerlache Rim (Artemis III region)
sites.note: LROC mosaic titled 'de Gerlache Rim' (87.8-89.0 S); may cover both rim regions of NASA's lists. Mosaic centre, not an official point.

sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus (landed 2024)
sites.note: Actual CLPS landing site near Malapert A, measured by LROC.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena (landed 2025)
sites.note: Actual CLPS landing site on Mons Mouton (lander tipped over in a small crater), measured by LROC.

sites.name: VIPER target area (Mons Mouton)
sites.note: VIPER was to explore the western edge of Nobile crater on Mons Mouton; no published point - this is the mountain's feature centre.

sites.name: Chang'e-7 planned target
sites.note: Planned landing near a peak by the Shackleton rim; weakly sourced, approximate.

sites.name: Lunar south pole (90 S)
sites.note: The rotation pole itself (on the Shackleton rim area).

sites.name: Luna-25 planned site
sites.note: Planned primary site north of Boguslawsky crater; the probe crashed in 2023. Outside the 80 S DEM coverage.

sites.name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram (Statio Shiv Shakti)
sites.note: Landed 2023 at about 69 S - outside the polar DEM coverage.

sites.name: Apollo 11 (Tranquility Base)
sites.note: Equatorial reference site - outside coverage.

sites.name: Chang'e-4
sites.note: Far-side landing in Von Karman crater (2019) - outside coverage.

sites.name: Chang'e-6
sites.note: Far-side sample return from the Apollo basin (2024) - outside coverage.

sites.name: SLIM
sites.note: JAXA precision lander near Shioli crater (2024) - outside coverage.

sites.name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
sites.note: CLPS landing in Mare Crisium (2025) - outside coverage.
